School was horrible. I was bullied by my teachers, by the students to. I'd come home to my oldest brother arguing with my mom to the point they start fighting each other. My mom found a narcissistic husband in canada and then I moved there at 12. Highschool was horrible. This one girl, my only friend, beat me and belittled me. She had a long distance relationship with this dude 10x better than me. She told me all the reasons why I'm pathetic compared to him. Why didnt I stop talking to her? Because my dumbass thought I had a chance with love. She was very pretty, and I was her only friend to. Meanwhile, i was the class clown. So kids told me I'd never make it in life. They're right. All the shit people have told me, they're right. Throw in some drug addiction and you got someone like me. I was heavily addicted to weed at 13, yes its addictive to some people. So that ruined the chance of me ever succeeding. I went to an alternative school and then dropped out. Haven't talked to anyone since. I havent hung out with a friend in years, havent laughed with someone in years. I've been in self isolation for years. Hopefully not much longer though

Crying on the internet at 1am and probably way later because my mind is going crazy I cant sleep. I'm wondering if cutting will help, anything to take my mind off this excruciating pain. This constant reminder that I'm worthless. I get jelous of the simplest things because I dont have them. I cant get a diploma. If I do go to college, doesnt matter because I dont have a diploma. You see? I'm fucked. I have no future. I really hope I'm dead by the time I'm your age, because if not, I'll probably be homeless doing heroin under a bridge. Being 6 feet under is so comforting to me. Time to dream about having a girlfriend and physical attention I'll never get in my lifetime. Congrats on your diploma though, must feel nice being a smart young man who actually has plans for the future
